name: WWWCW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Held by Godfather, who retains it against Masked Judge by double disqualification at Hog Wild 97 when a stable war interrupts the match.
notes: No won-date for Godfather's own reign survives; the double-DQ result is a defense, not a title change.

name: WWWCW Intercontinental Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Changes hands at Hog Wild 97 after outside interference from both the Wolf Pack and the Foundation.

name: WWWCW United States Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Awarded to War Dog on the same night he lost the Intercontinental title match, per the fed's own on-air ruling at On Your Screen -- an unusual mechanic recorded as the fed's own writing staged it.

name: WWWCW Extreme Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Introduced at Hog Wild 97 via a five-man Chicken Coop weapons match, its debut and only recorded reign in this collection's holdings.

name: WWWCW Heavyweight Tag-Team Championship
epitaph: Held by the Twin Sisters (Crazy Phill & Lunatic Larry), who retain it against The Graveyard by disqualification at Hog Wild 97 -- the same show on which The Graveyard and a third wrestler are announced to have quit the fed.
notes: No won-date for the Twin Sisters' own reign survives.

name: WWWCW Alliance Championship
epitaph: Contested in a five-man stable-war survival match between the Wolf Pack and the Foundation at Alliance Armageddon, resolved when a masked interloper unmasks as a roster member to hand the Foundation the win.
